title: Daily Tasks
tagline: An iPhone home-screen app that pushes me to start tasks on time, and checks that I finished them.
highlights: Installable PWA with Web Push: a "time to start" alert, then "did you finish?" follow-ups until the task is done or skipped
One-off tasks and tasks that repeat on chosen weekdays
Lock Screen widget through Scriptable, using a read-only link
One Node.js server with a single dependency, in Docker behind Caddy with automatic HTTPS
role: Solo: server, PWA, push notifications, deployment
problem: Calendar reminders tell you when something starts, but never check that you did it. I wanted a phone app that nudges me at a task's start time and keeps asking, politely, until I mark it done or skip it.

challenges.title: Push notifications on an iPhone without an App Store app
challenges.body: iOS only allows Web Push for apps added to the Home Screen and served over HTTPS. The app is an installable PWA with a service worker, and Caddy provides automatic certificates on a free DuckDNS hostname.

challenges.title: Follow-ups that don't nag forever
challenges.body: A tick loop on the server sends "did you finish?" 10 minutes after a task's estimate runs out, then every 30 minutes, at most 3 times. All three numbers are settings, and tapping the notification opens that exact task.

challenges.title: A Lock Screen widget with no native app
challenges.body: A Scriptable script reads a read-only link that can only see today's tasks, so the widget never holds the app password.
